caseName: United States v. Lehigh Valley Railroad
caseNameFull: United States v. Lehigh Valley Railroad Company

opinions.text: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of New York. Motion to amend decree submitted December 16,1920. Decided December 20, 1920. Motion to modify the decree of this court denied. The Solicitor General for the United States. Mr. Edgar H. Boles for appellees. See ante, 255.
